욥기 6:2.content: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

욥기 6:3.content: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

욥기 6:4.content: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

욥기 6:5.content: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

욥기 6:6.content: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

욥기 6:7.content: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.

욥기 6:8.content: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

욥기 6:9.content: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

욥기 6:10.content: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

욥기 6:11.content: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?

욥기 6:12.content: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

욥기 6:13.content: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

욥기 6:14.content: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

욥기 6:15.content: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;

욥기 6:16.content: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:

욥기 6:17.content: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

욥기 6:18.content: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

욥기 6:19.content: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

욥기 6:20.content: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

욥기 6:21.content: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.

욥기 6:22.content: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

욥기 6:23.content: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

욥기 6:24.content: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

욥기 6:25.content: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

욥기 6:26.content: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?

욥기 6:27.content: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.

욥기 6:28.content: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.

욥기 6:29.content: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.

욥기 6:30.content: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
